basic_details.job_title: ICMR-NIRT Trade Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Library Science Apprentice, Mechanic Motor Vehicle Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICMR–National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis, Chennai, has invited applications for 5 Trade Apprentice posts: 3 Mechanic Motor Vehicle / Diesel Mechanic and 2 Library Science Apprentice. Applications go by post to The Director at No. 1, Mayor Sathyamoorthy Road, Chetpet, Chennai – 600 031, and must reach on or before 10 December 2026, by 5:00 PM.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: IIT in the relevant trade from a recognized institute (as printed in the notice). Freshers can also apply. Age: not more than 30 years. | Essential qualification: Bachelor/Master degree in Library Science from a recognized university. Freshers can also apply. Age: not more than 30 years. | Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, are not eligible. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

selection_process: Selection is based on performance in the interview from among the shortlisted candidates. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria or the interview date
and states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on an apprenticeship basis under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and does not confer any right for regular employment at ICMR–NIRT. The engagement is for one year, with extension/renewal based on institutional requirements. The institute reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of apprentices or cancel the notification without assigning any reason. The decision of the Institute in all matters relating to the selection shall be final.

content_sections.heading: About ICMR-NIRT
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the ICMR–National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis, Chennai, with its office at Chetpet, Chennai. The institute is engaging Trade Apprentices under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 (as amended up to 2019), on a short-term basis for one year, with extension/renewal based on institutional requirements.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates may submit their application in the prescribed format attached with the notice, along with self-attested copies of relevant documents and a photograph affixed. The application is addressed to: The Director, ICMR-National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis, No. 1, Mayor Sathyamoorthy Road, Chetpet, Chennai – 600 031 The application should reach the above address on or before 10.12.2026, by 5:00 PM. The notice does not mention the postal mode, any text to write on the envelope, or an email address.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: IIT in the relevant trade from a recognized institute (as printed in the notice). Freshers can also apply. Age: not more than 30 years. Essential qualification: Bachelor/Master degree in Library Science from a recognized university. Freshers can also apply. Age: not more than 30 years. Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, are not eligible. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format attached with the notice. Self-attested copies of relevant documents. A photograph affixed to the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on performance in the interview from among the shortlisted candidates. The notice does not describe the shortlisting criteria or the interview date, and states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of application

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on an apprenticeship basis under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and does not confer any right for regular employment at ICMR–NIRT. The engagement is for one year, with extension/renewal based on institutional requirements. The institute reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of apprentices or cancel the notification without assigning any reason. The decision of the Institute in all matters relating to the selection shall be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICMR-NIRT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 Trade Apprentice vacancies: 3 for Mechanic Motor Vehicle / Diesel Mechanic and 2 for Library Science Apprentice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ICMR-NIRT apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Director's office on or before 10.12.2026, by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Library Science Apprentice post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor/Master degree in Library Science from a recognized university is required. Freshers can also apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Mechanic Motor Vehicle / Diesel Mechanic post?
faq.answer: The notice prints "IIT in the relevant trade from a recognized institute". Freshers can also apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 30 years for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for ICMR-NIRT apprentices?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs.15,000/- per month (consolidated) for both posts.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format with self-attested copies of relevant documents and a photograph, addressed to The Director, ICMR-National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis, No. 1, Mayor Sathyamoorthy Road, Chetpet, Chennai – 600 031.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the interview from among the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is an apprenticeship under the Apprentices Act, 1961 for one year, with extension/renewal based on institutional requirements, and it gives no right to regular employment at ICMR–NIRT.

faq.question: Q10. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training, or are currently undergoing it under the Apprentices Act, 1961, are not eligible.
